user.title: Frigate camera panel
user.description: Which Frigate instance should the panel show the cameras of?

abort.no_frigate: Set up the Frigate integration first: the panel shows its cameras.
abort.already_configured: Every Frigate instance already has a camera panel.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: The camera panel for this Frigate instance. Changes show after the page is reloaded.

data.name: Title
data.show_stats: Show the stream's resolution, bitrate and frame rate
data.clip_before: Clips start this long before an event
data.clip_after: Clips end this long after an event

data_description.panel: Untick to keep using a panel_custom panel from configuration.yaml instead.
data_description.url_path: The panel opens at this address, e.g. cameras for /cameras. Dashboard buttons and notifications link to it.
data_description.sidebar: Without it, the panel opens only from a link, such as a dashboard button or a notification. Anyone with the link can still open it.
data_description.name: Shown in the sidebar.
data_description.low_bandwidth: Each camera's lighter stream (a substream) saves mobile data.
data_description.home_hosts: Separated by commas, e.g. 192.168.1.10, homeassistant.local. Blank: any private network address counts as at home.
data_description.talk_quality: The lighter stream leaves more room for the sound. It needs the talk source too (see the README).

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.description: The cameras the panel shows, from Frigate's config. A camera without a stream in Frigate's go2rtc can't be watched live, so the panel leaves it out.

camera.title: Camera settings
camera.description: Which camera's settings would you like to change?

camera_settings.title: Camera settings
camera_settings.description: Frigate camera {camera}. Each setting starts from what Frigate's config says.

data_description.stream: The go2rtc stream to watch and talk through.
data_description.stream_low: A substream, used to save data. Blank: always the stream above.
data_description.talk: Needs the camera's RTSP source, with its backchannel, in go2rtc (see the README).
data_description.ptz: Through Frigate, which needs ONVIF set up for the camera.
data_description.presets: Frigate's preset names for the camera, separated by commas, as one-tap buttons.
data_description.labels: Objects to show in the activity feed. Blank: everything Frigate tracks.
data_description.aspect_ratio: Width/height, e.g. 16/9. Blank: from the camera's detect resolution.
data_description.doorbell_entity: When it turns on, an open panel switches to this camera.

error.url_path_invalid: Use lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens, starting with a letter or number.
error.url_path_reserved: Home Assistant already uses this address.
error.url_path_taken: Another camera panel already has this address.

abort.frigate_not_ready: The Frigate integration isn't set up at the moment. Try again once it is.

options.auto: On mobile data, with Data Saver on, or away from home
options.mobile: On mobile data or with Data Saver on
